newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak govt approves trading of foreign securities.
newsitem.headline: Slovak govt approves trading of foreign securities.

text.p: The Slovak government on Tuesday approved a new securities law allowing the trading of foreign securities on the domestic market.
"The aim of the amendment has been to adjust the current securities law to OECD standards," a government statement said.
Slovakia is a candidate for OECD membership with a final decision on the matter expected later this year.
"The law allows trading with foreign securities on the Slovak capital market and also allows the issuance of foreign securities in Slovakia," the statement said.
It did not give any further details.
The amendment must be still approved by parliament.
Last December, parliament approved a different amendment to the securities law forcing the trading of registered shares onto accredited bourses.
In addition to barring trading outside officially registered markets, it also banned changes of registered shares into bearer shares, which was permitted under the previous law.
